buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 7 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C NOIDA . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.

6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) The Bidder/OEM profile must not be red marked. A screenshot for the same must be attached in bid do cuments. (2) The Bidder/OEM profile’s rating not below then 4.50 rating on GeM. A screenshot for the same must be attached in the bid documents. (3) The Bidder/OEM should have ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 , ISO 45001: 2018, ISO 20957-1:2024 (4) The bidder must comply the provisions under rule 144 (xi) of the 2017 GFR rule. (5) Data Sheet on OEM Letter Head. (6) Non -Blacklisting Declaration The Bidder and OEM must not have been blacklisted by any government i nstitution within the last five year s. A declaration regarding this must be provided on a ₹100 notarized sta mp paper (7) Bid Security Declaration on Rs. 10/- Stamp Paper (8) Audited Balance Sheet Should be submitted with UDIN of Minimum Last two Financial Years. (9) EMD (Rs. 47843.00/-) with third party FDR to be submitted with bid documents as scanned cop y. Physi cal copy of the EMD is to be deposited by bidder to A.D (Horticulture), Div-3, New Okhla Industrial Develop ment Authority, Sector-39, Noida within 3 days of Bid end date. (10). GST Registration Certificate. 7. Affidavit on Rs. 10/- Stamp paper showing Turnover of Agency notariz ed. 8. CA Certificate for Turnover with UDI No. (11). ITR Last 3 Financial Year. (12). If in Case The Seller Is Unable to Execute the Supply of Material As per Bid Specification Within Sched uled time Then The Seller Will Be Blacklisted/Debarred by the Buyer. (13). “Bidders claiming exemption under the MSME category shall submit valid MSME/Udyam Registration Certificates and other relevant supporting documents. The authenticity and validity of such documents sh all be verified from the concerned issuing authority. The benefit of MSME exemption shall be allowed only aft er successful verification of the submitted documents and confirmation of the bidder’s eligibility, in acc ordance with the applicable rules and guidelines. In case any document is found to be false, invalid, or the bid der is found ineligible, the benefit of MSME exemption shall not be extended, and further action shall b e ta 6 / 8 ken as per applicable rules.” (14). EXPERIENCE (WITH GOVERMENT/SEMI-GOVERMENT/PSUS ONLY) completed works during the last 3 ye ars ending last day of the month previous to the one in which application are invited. One similar complete d works each costing not less than the amount equal to 30% of estimated cost put to tender in last 3 finan cial years. (15) Playground Equipment Safety and Maintenance Standards A. The bidder shall ensure that all inspection, maintenance, repair and replacement activities of playgroun

d equipment, including swings, slides, seesaws, climbing structures and multi-play stations, are carried out in accordance with the applicable safety requirements of EN 1176 series, particularly EN 1176-1, EN 1176- 2, EN 1176-3, EN 1176-6 and EN 1176-7, wherever applicable, or equivalent Indian Standards, wherever av ailable. B. The contractor shall undertake periodic inspection of all equipment, including structural stability, found ation, joints, fasteners, welding, moving parts, corrosion, sharp edges and safety surfacing. A proper inspe ction and maintenance register shall be maintained and submitted to the Engineer-in-Charge as and when required. C. Any equipment found unsafe for public use shall be immediately isolated and reported to the Engineer-i n-Charge for necessary corrective action. . 10.
